item.title: Understanding Multilevel Modeling: A Visual Approach
item.dc:creator: Hyeonwoo Jeong
item.description:
Introduction

In this post, we will explore the foundational concepts of Multilevel Modeling (MLM). When dealing with nested data, standard OLS regression assumptions are often violated due to grouped errors.

Data Visualization with Code

We can simulate and plot this relationship directly within our post.

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import numpy as np

Sample plot generation

x = np.linspace(0, 10, 100) y = 2 + 1.5 * x + np.random.normal(0, 1, 100)

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4)) plt.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.6, color=‘blue’) plt.title(“Simulated Nested Data”) plt.show()
